LanguageData.RAF_Safety_rimexodus_seamlessworld: fixed by this mod: map sleep/wake follows synced player presence instead of each camera, maps generate synchronously, cross-map orders and map gizmos are synced, all players' pawns/homes are counted; with async time empty tiles run no faster than normal speed and are hidden from the colonist bar; trading with a settlement on its own map is disabled; settings locked in game - keep Sync configs on
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ferny_perspectiveshift: drives a pawn from the keyboard inside the tick, without sync
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_memegoddess_replacestuff: over-rock blueprints, fog, cancel above bridges, bridge order and saving fixed by this mod; the 'Replace' stuff choice is synced
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_jellycreative_isekaileveling: gaps in Multiplayer Compatibility closed by this mod (auto-distribute, runes in the tick, drop zone, ranks, caches, guild quests and title duels per player); settings locked in game - keep Sync configs on
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_mehni_pickupandhaul: settings (capacity, corpses, animals) affect job choice - turn on Sync configs and don't change them in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_m00nl1ght_mappreview: seed reroll and in-game preview disabled by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_co_uk_epicguru_meleeanimation: decorative mode: executions, duels, lasso and skills disabled by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_nals_facialanimation: component tick disabled, randomness isolated by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_fuu_bloodanimations: randomness isolated, no filth from animations
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_unlimitedhugs_allowtool: Multiplayer Compatibility; keep Sync configs on
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_NeedsMpCompat: works in multiplayer only through Multiplayer Compatibility, which is not loaded - expect desyncs. Add it to the mod list (after Multiplayer, before this mod)
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_TitleBreak: These mods break multiplayer sync - desyncs will happen:
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_TitleRisk: These mods may cause desyncs in multiplayer:
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ClientBreak: The mod list contains mods incompatible with multiplayer (details in the log).

LanguageData.RAF_Evacuated: The settlement where your colonists were has closed - they left as a caravan.
LanguageData.RAF_SettingsMismatch: Mod settings differ between players (groups of players with identical settings):
LanguageData.RAF_ReplaceStuffSettingsLocked: Replace Stuff settings affect the simulation and are locked during a multiplayer game.
LanguageData.RAF_IsekaiSettingsLocked: Isekai RPG Leveling settings are locked during a multiplayer game: they affect the simulation and must be identical on every client. Change them from the main menu (all players must use the same values).
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_SettingsLocked: RimExodus settings are locked during a multiplayer game: the simulation reads them, so they must be identical on every client. Change them from the main menu (all players must use the same values).
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_SettlementTalkMp: Talking to a settlement trader on its own map is not available in multiplayer: the trade would happen on one computer only. Trade with a caravan from the world map.
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_MapViewed: Someone is looking at this map right now - it can't be put to sleep or removed.
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_MapNotYours: Another player has colonists or a home area on this map.
LanguageData.RAF_DesyncAnalysisHeader: Desync analysis: mods on the code path where the game diverged (most likely first).
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_smashphil_vehicleframework: fixed by this mod: the caravan window is no longer empty, vehicle caravans are sent and re-formed for everyone, seat assignment and group boarding are synced; needs Multiplayer Compatibility
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ceteam_combatextended: fixed by this mod: black smoke is computed in a fixed order, CE settings are checked and locked in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_cemp_desyncfix: not needed: this mod fixes Combat Extended itself (its duplicate smoke handler is switched off)
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_memegoddess_runandgun: fixed by this mod: light/forbidden weapon lists are filled the same for every player (they were empty until the settings window was opened), settings are checked and locked in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_memegoddess_giddyup: the Multiplayer Compatibility patch did not apply to this version; mounting, gizmos, caravan riders and the animals tab are synced by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_vanillaexpanded_gravship2: fixed by this mod: the enemy warplatform is generated the same for everyone (it was generated in a background long event), turret accuracy buff is applied the same way
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ancot_milirarace: fixed by this mod: flight and leap orders, flight/resonance/hair buttons, Milian tables and manual priorities are synced, story raids and Milian gear use the same map for everyone, settings are checked and locked in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_redmattis_betterprerequisites: fixed by this mod: the raid infiltrator roll no longer depends on an unsaved tick counter (raiders differed between players), the size/stat cache is created and refreshed only by the simulation
LanguageData.RAF_SimSettingsLocked: {0} settings are locked during a multiplayer game: the simulation reads them, so they must be identical on every client. Change them from the main menu (all players must use the same values).
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_vanillaexpanded_vfepropsandde: fixed by this mod: prop cost no longer depends on each player's dev mode, silver is taken from the prop's own map, settings are checked and locked in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ancot_ancotlibrary: fixed by this mod: turret, drone, aerocraft, shield, carrier and weapon buttons and sliders are synced, aerocraft landing works, targeting orders and royal permits are synced, settings are checked and locked in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_erdelf_humanoidalienraces: Multiplayer Compatibility syncs the styling station; this mod repairs its alien colour sync for the current HAR version

LanguageData.RAF_Safety_keullaeseu_har: not needed: Multiplayer Compatibility with this mod's repair already syncs the styling station
